review_description: The Professional service provided by Green Ninja Electrical really gave us piece of mind throughout the whole process. It was reassuring to know that Green Ninja Electrical are qualified Electricians doing Solar installations.
Very professional team. Neat installation. Good communication.

Installer prepared to advise re pro and cons of cheaper systems-adviising customer re a Government Research Website so as to make up own mind as to the System to install.(This was backed up by Negative reports on the Media re the cheaper and older Systems!) All aspects in relation to to the System installed as advised by the Installer eventuated .Doubt that there is a better Installer on the market!System installed was German Q cells and Delta Inverter 2.5kw.Would  recommend this Installer to anyone!This 9 Panel System produced a Refund of $1048 after 9 months.
